layout_sources: https://github.com/mlaitinen/ofxstatement-revolut/tree/master/tests/samples (2021 and 2022 exports: the 10-column header, Started/Completed Date "yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss", signed Amount, Fee, Currency, State COMPLETED, Balance after the line, oldest first, UTF-8)
notes: Revolut app "Statement" as Excel/CSV for the EUR current account (Revolut Bank UAB, Irish branch): comma-separated, unquoted unless a value holds a comma, the started and completed date-times, a signed Amount with a point decimal, Fee, Currency EUR, State, and Balance after the line. Oldest first, LF, UTF-8. All lines start and complete on the same day here, so the date is not ambiguous; no fees. Closing = the last line's balance; opening = the first line's balance minus its amount.
